t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Patutuanan cu, O Guinu cu, Ica ing linalang canacu ba racang aquilala at samban. Patutuan cu caniting oras a iti, ing canacung que inan, at qng Quecang Cayupayan, qng cacaluluan, at qng quecang pibandian. Alang aliuan Dios nung e mu Ica, ing casaupan qng Pañganib, ing alang angga.
